Answer: B
Reason: Comparing the pre-operative image (Figure 1a), which shows a massive right-sided opacity causing leftward mediastinal shift, with the post-operative image (Figure 1c), the heart and trachea remain shifted to the left despite the removal of the mass. The right lung has re-expanded but remains partially opaque with volume loss, indicating only partial re-expansion rather than complete clearing.
